solutions.title: Weighted graph DFS per query
solutions.strategy: Build a bidirectional weighted graph and search a path for each query, multiplying edge ratios along the path.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each query can visit every variable and ratio edge in its connected component.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency map stores two directed weighted edges for every equation plus a visited set during search.

solutions.title: Weighted union find
solutions.strategy: Maintain connected components with each variable's ratio to its parent, so queries compare ratios to a shared root.

timeComplexity.explanation: Union and find operations are inverse-Ackermann amortized with path compression.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Parent and weight maps store one entry per distinct variable.
